concept.subject: Soap bubbles drifting through a sunny garden: two clear bubbles with pearly rims and a handful of faint, out-of-focus ones in front of soft sage greenery.
concept.composition: One clear bubble high on the left, at about a quarter of the width and a quarter of the height; the larger clear bubble right of the middle, at two thirds of the width and just over half the height. Most faint bubbles gather on the right: a large one right of the top center, one cut off by the top right edge and one at the right edge just under three fifths of the height; three more float low, at a third, three fifths and four fifths of the width. The left half under the clear bubble is open green; the top center is calm.
concept.layout: Bricks only, 127. Eight bubbles, each a ring of 12 or 13 curved bricks with a small opening at the bottom, float on small circles of radius 16 over the picture's bubbles, most neighbors circling opposite ways; the two cut off by the right edge are moved in far enough to float. The open left half holds three brick rims that sweep from beside the cannon toward the left wall: the upper and lower slides, steep where a plain shot falls onto them and flatter further out, each ridden whole by one shot, and a short third rim above the left flipper. A fourth rim slopes from between the bubbles on the right to the right wall, where flat shots to the right land. Nothing within 210 px of the cannon can be orange: the sides of the two nearest bubbles that face it and the upper slide's top two bricks.

moving.what: eight bubbles, each a ring of curved bricks floating on a small circle

features: Bricks only (spec 8): the first of stage 7's two bricks-only levels

difficulty.note: Second easiest: the two slides light ten or eleven bricks a shot, but nothing within 210 px of the cannon can be orange, so the orange spreads over the slides, the far sides of the near bubbles, the big bubble and the far bubbles that drift as they are aimed at. With orange allowed everywhere the same layout cleared 57% under the stage's power.

background.prompt: A photo of soap bubbles drifting through a sunny garden, the greenery behind them out of focus in soft sage, a little lighter along the top. One clear bubble with a pearly, faintly pink rim hangs high on the left, centered at about a quarter of the width and a quarter of the height and about a seventh of the picture wide; a larger clear bubble, about a fifth of the picture wide, floats right of the middle at about two thirds of the width and just over half the height. Faint, out-of-focus bubbles show as pale discs on the right: a large one right of the top center at two thirds of the width and a quarter of the height, one cut off by the right edge at a fifth of the height, one at the right edge at three fifths of the height, and three low in the picture at about a third, three fifths and four fifths of the width, at about five sixths of the height. Partial bubbles touch the bottom right and bottom left corners. The left half below the clear bubble is open green; the top center is calm.

picture.title: Colorful soap bubbles floating in a garden, reflecting light on a sunny day.
picture.author: Christina & Peter
